summary: Libbie Mills is an Indologist who completed her D.Phil. at the University of Oxford under Alexis Sanderson in 2011. She held a post teaching Sanskrit and Pali at the University of Toronto (attested 2020).
Lili Zheng is a Buddhist studies scholar. She completed an MA at Fo Guang University under the supervision of Yongdong Shi (attested 2011).

Lilian Silburn (1908–1993) was a scholar of Indology, philosophy, and Buddhist studies. She studied under Paul Masson-Oursel and traditional teacher Swami Lakshman Joo (1948), and worked at the CNRS / National Centre for Scientific Research from circa 1948 to 1978.

Lilla Russell-Smith is a scholar of Buddhist studies, history and archaeology, and Iranian and Central Asian studies. She studied under Anna Eörsi and Pál Miklós, and earned her PhD from SOAS University of London.

Limei Chi is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Sinology who studied under Jinhua Chen. Attested in 2026, she held faculty posts at the International College for Postgraduate Buddhist Studies and as Professor at the International Institute for Buddhist Studies.

Lin He (1902–1992) was a philosopher who studied at Tsinghua University (National Tsing Hua University) from circa 1919 to 1926. He later held an academic post at National Tsing Hua University from circa 1931 to 1937.
Lin Heng is a scholar of Indology and Buddhist studies. He earned an MA at Silpakorn University under the supervision of Chainarong Klinnoi (attested 2015).
Lin Li is a scholar in computational linguistics who held posts at Utrecht University and Qinghai Normal University.

Linda Hogan (born 1964) is a religious studies scholar who earned a PhD at Trinity College Dublin in 1991. She held posts at Chester, Leeds, and Trinity College Dublin, where she was appointed Chair of Ecumenics and Vice-Provost.
Linda Jean LaMacchia is a scholar of religious studies and Indology. She earned her PhD at the University of Wisconsin-Madison under the doctoral supervision of David M. Knipe (attested 2001).
Linda Learman is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Sinology. She studied under doctoral supervisor Robert P. Weller and postdoctoral mentor Peter N. Gregory (attested 2005).
Linda Penkower is a scholar of Buddhist studies, Sinology, and religious studies. She earned her PhD from Columbia University in 1993 and was a research fellow at Taisho University (attested 1983).
Lindsay G. McCune is a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies. She studied under Kathleen M. Erndl, John Corrigan, and MA supervisor Bryan J. Cuevas.
Lindy Li Mark is a scholar of Sinology who held posts as professor of anthropology at California State University, East Bay, and The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
Ling Ji is a Sinologist who earned a PhD at the National University of Singapore under the supervision of Yuet Keung Lo (attested 2014).

Linnart Mäll (1938–2010) was an Estonian scholar of Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and Indology. He studied at the University of Tartu (~1957–1962) and under Bidia Dandaron (~1966–1972), later holding a post at the University of Tartu from circa 1969 to 2010.

Lionel David Barnett (1871–1960) was a scholar of Indology and history. He studied at Liverpool and Cambridge, held keeper positions at the British Museum (1899–1936, 1948), and taught at UCL (1906–1917) and SOAS (1917–1948).

Lionel Obadia (born 1968) is a scholar of religious and Buddhist studies who earned his PhD from the University of Lille (1997). He held posts at INALCO, KU Leuven, EPHE, Lille III, and as Professor at Lumière University Lyon 2.

Liqian Liu (1910–2008) worked in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He held posts at West China Union University, the translation administration department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, and the Ethnic Publishing House.

Lisa Grumbach is a scholar of Buddhist studies, Japanology, and religious studies. She has held posts at Stanford University (attested 1996) and as an assistant professor at the Institute of Buddhist Studies.
